filed_by: TI Sigma DPES agent on Brandon Emerick directive (Pass 25)
predecessor_studies: analyses/tsc_h4_sat_r20_replication/ (r20: averaged_energy_auc_inverted = 0.7318, bare H_TSC, π-derived seed)
Pass-24 §5 four-way conjecture: BOK Crystal × Penrose × Orch-OR × LCC composite, predicted AUC band [0.65, 0.78]
hypothesis_under_test: The composite augmented Hamiltonian H_composite = H_TSC + lambda_P * H_Penrose_pinning + lambda_LCC * diag(LCC_v3_rolling) produces averaged-energy AUC inside the predicted [0.65, 0.78] band on a fresh 3-SAT corpus. CONFIRM in-band; PARTIAL if R-A inverted-H4 survives but Penrose+LCC additivity is null; DISCONFIRM otherwise.

design.instance_seed_rationale: e-derived; deliberately distinct from r20's pi-derived seed=31415927 to guarantee zero instance overlap.
design.lambda_rationale: Both fixed BEFORE any data collection per anti-HARK; no tuning permitted post-hoc.
design.mapping_seed_rationale: Independent per-(instance, k) seed of form (instance_seed * 10007) + (i * 31337) + k, identical recipe to r20.
design.scoring: averaged_energy_auc_inverted as primary; per-mapping AUC distribution + per-mapping R_t logged simultaneously (also discharges Pass-25 g25).

pre_registered_decision_rules.definition: 1 - AUC['lower-E ⇒ SAT'] computed on per-instance mean H_composite-energy across K=100 mappings.

rules.CONFIRM_composite: 0.65 <= AUC <= 0.78 → Pass-24 §5 composite prediction CONFIRMED on this corpus; the four-way fit BOK + Penrose + Orch-OR + LCC is empirically supported.
rules.PARTIAL_R_A_only: 0.55 <= AUC < 0.65 OR 0.78 < AUC <= 0.85 → R-A inverted-H4 survives on H_composite but composite prediction itself does not distinguish from bare H_TSC (Penrose + LCC additivity is null).
rules.DISCONFIRM: AUC < 0.55 OR AUC > 0.85 → composite prediction REJECTED; either R-A fails on H_composite (low) or composite over-shoots (high).

secondary_metrics: Pearson r(per_map_R_t, per_map_auc_inverted) with permutation p (n=10000)
delta_vs_r20: (this AUC) - 0.7318 (positive means composite outperforms bare H_TSC)

anti_hark_safeguards: Decision thresholds frozen in this JSON BEFORE the runner is executed.
lambda_P and lambda_LCC frozen at 0.5 and 0.3; no tuning permitted post-hoc.
No re-runs with alternative seeds permitted. If the seed produces a degenerate corpus (n_sat < 30 or n_unsat < 30), the result is reported AS-IS as a corpus-quality failure.
The decision rule is deterministic and tri-state (CONFIRM_composite / PARTIAL_R_A_only / DISCONFIRM) on the primary metric ONLY. Secondary metrics are reported but do NOT trigger a decision flip.
If CONFIRM, the result still requires 3rd-party / 3rd-corpus replication before being claimed beyond TI-Sigma-internal confirmation.
expected_outcome_under_composite_strong: averaged_energy_auc_inverted in [0.72, 0.78] (above r20 baseline 0.7318) → CONFIRM verdict.
expected_outcome_under_R_A_only: averaged_energy_auc_inverted in [0.55, 0.65) → PARTIAL verdict; Penrose + LCC are within-noise of bare Hamiltonian.
run_trigger: Brandon ratification of either g25-MATRIX-V2 (Pass-25 §4.3) OR a separate explicit go-ahead for r25-COMPOSITE.
next_step_after_run: Append observed value + verdict to results.json; cite this pre-registration JSON in the Pass-26 paper §1 verbatim.
